## What changes

## How it was checked

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] Tried in the program (and in Roblox, if it changes playing)

## If it changes interface text

- [ ] The key exists in `guitar_player/locales/zh-CN.json` and `en.json`; other languages fall back to English until translated
- [ ] Placeholders such as `{count}` are unchanged in every language
